evidence_notes: GitHub release metadata shows rust-v0.139.0-alpha.3 was published at 2026-06-09T12:44:20Z with only a sparse release body.

The adjacent alpha.2 -> alpha.3 compare is diverged with 6 ahead commits and 1 behind commit in GitHub compare metadata.

PR-title metadata in the adjacent compare points to fsmonitor preservation for worktree Git reads, remote plugin install auth requirements, workspace-directory installed plugins, path-based MultiAgentV2 activity tracking, and stale app-server thread-watch cleanup after v2 agent interruption, but these behavior claims are unreviewed by this publisher automation.

The refreshed checked release_delta/v1 now records stable rust-v0.138.0 -> prerelease rust-v0.139.0-alpha.3 with 50 ahead commits and no tracked signal slugs; it does not replace the adjacent prerelease comparison required for alpha.3 publishing decisions.

Official Codex changelog readback for this run shows Codex CLI 0.138.0 on 2026-06-08 as the latest official CLI release entry, so alpha.3 is a GitHub prerelease checkpoint rather than an official Codex changelog entry.
Decodex PR #260 has unlanded upstream-review/impact artifacts for #27007, #27098, and #27166, while #26880 and #27085 remain release-window source-review gaps in the current checked tree.
